name: Use the code graph first
description: Seeded default. Asks the agent, on every message, to answer code-structure questions with the Harness Memory code tools before grep.

action.text: If the Harness Memory code tools (code_map, code_symbol, code_impact, code_path) are available, use them for code-structure questions before grep or reading files, and pass project_path. Use code_map for an unfamiliar area, code_symbol for where something is defined and who uses it, code_impact before changing a signature, and one code_path call to trace how A reaches B (a symbol, a file path, a command name or plain words work as an endpoint). If you grep to find a starting point, switch to code_path from the function you found. Use grep only for literal text, error messages, config values, or when a code tool says the repository is not indexed.
